_description: PHP-FPM on Alpine with the extensions a real CMS needs (gd with JPEG/PNG/WebP/FreeType, zip, intl, exif) compiled in, listening on 127.0.0.1:9000.
_comment: A RECIPE: `uxc deploy php-fpm` builds the image from the Dockerfile below, creates /srv/php-fpm + the webroot with the right owner, writes a pool override and registers the container. Pair it with the caddy (or nginx) recipe. NOTE: this is a BUILD, not a pull - the stock php:fpm-alpine image has none of these extensions, so uxcd records build provenance and `uxc upgrade php-fpm` RE-BUILDS on the current base image instead of pulling the stock one over it.

_source._comment_base: The tracked base image. check_updates re-resolves this tag and reports a rebuild when it moves; ${base} below expands to it, so the FROM line and the tracked ref can never drift apart. Pin a full version (php:8.5.10-fpm-alpine) if you want to move deliberately.

build._comment_dockerfile: A plain, standard Dockerfile - it builds with docker/podman too. The build-only deps go in a virtual package and are deleted again, so the layer stays small. -j2 keeps the compile inside a router's RAM.
dockerfile: RUN apk add --no-cache freetype libjpeg-turbo libpng libwebp libzip icu-libs \
&& apk add --no-cache --virtual .build-deps $PHPIZE_DEPS freetype-dev libjpeg-turbo-dev libpng-dev libwebp-dev libzip-dev icu-dev \

_comment_paths: PHP runs as uid/gid 82 (www-data on Alpine). The webroot must be writable by it or the application fails in ways that look like anything but a permission problem - this is exactly the detail a redeploy otherwise loses.
_comment_seed: The pool override. Written only when absent, so your tuning survives a redeploy.

/srv/php-fpm/conf/zz-site.conf: ; Pool override written by `uxc deploy php-fpm`. EDIT ME.
; Loaded after the stock pool config, so these win.
; Process manager: 'dynamic' suits a box serving a handful of sites.
; On a small router 'ondemand' with a low max_children uses less RAM.
; Send the workers' output to the container log (`uxc log php-fpm`).

_registry._comment_stop: php-fpm's graceful shutdown signal: SIGTERM kills requests in flight.
_registry._comment_health: Checked from INSIDE the container, so it works the same whether the container is on the host stack or in an infra netns.
_registry.notes: Deployed from the 'php-fpm' recipe - a BUILD, not a pull: gd/zip/intl/exif are compiled in and the stock php:fpm-alpine image does NOT have them. `uxc upgrade php-fpm` rebuilds from the recorded Dockerfile (/srv/php-fpm.Dockerfile) on the current base image; never replace the bundle with a plain image pull. Pool override: /srv/php-fpm/conf/zz-site.conf. Webroot /srv/htdocs is owned by 82:82. Needs a web server in front (the caddy recipe) sharing the same network - the host stack, or the same --infra netns.
